Customer Obsession：私たちは、お客様のビジネス目標を深く理解し、技術的な達成ではなく、ビジネス成果の実現に徹底してコミットします。全社員がお客様と直接向き合い、その声を聞き、現場を理解します。お客様に問題が起きたときは、他のすべてに優先して対応し、一刻も早く解決します。

Craftsmanship：私たちは、文章からシステムアーキテクチャまで、あらゆる細部にこだわります。良いものを見極める審美眼を持ち、違和感を見過ごさず、時間を惜しまず改善します。自らが生み出すプロダクトに誇りを持ち、振り返りと改善を繰り返しながら、常により良い仕事を追求します。

Intensity：私たちは、スピードが勝敗を分けることを理解しています。常に勝つために行動し、自分たちのプロダクトが最高であることを追求します。そうでないと分かれば、すぐに改善します。失敗は責めるためではなく、次に成功するための学びとしてオープンに共有します。

Family：私たちは、ワークライフバランスと高い成果へのこだわりは両立できると考え、それを自らの行動や組織の仕組みで体現します。子育てをする人にとって最高のテクノロジー企業であることを目指します。互いを支え、尊重し、一人ひとりの仕事上・私生活での成果や喜びをともに祝います。

あなたらしく、私たちと共に
私たちは、AIの変革的な力を世界中のあらゆる組織にもたらすことを目指しています。そのためには、社員の多様性がお客様の多様性を反映していることが重要だと考えています。チーム内のさまざまなスキルや経験を奨励し、支援し、尊重することで、私たちの仕事や文化はより良いものになると信じています。あなたの経験が募集要項に完全に一致していなくても、応募を歓迎します。私たちは、人種、肌の色、宗教、性別、国籍、年齢、障害、退役軍人としての地位、妊娠、性表現および性自認、性的指向、市民権、その他法律で保護されているいかなる属性に関わらず、すべての応募者を一貫して公平に評価するよう努めています。

jobs.title: エンタープライズ・セールス・エンジニア (Enterprise Sales Engineer)
jobs.description:

私たちは、行動の核となり、当社の文化を定義する一連の価値観を指針としています。それらの価値観とは、Trust、Customer Obsession、Craftsmanship、Intensity、Familyです。これらが私たちの仕事の基盤であり、あらゆる活動においてこれらを維持・実践することに全力を注いでいます。

社内チームとの連携：セールス、プロダクト、エージェントエンジニアリングの各チームと直接連携し、当社の顧客主導のプロダクト開発思想に基づき、GTMの推進とエージェント製品の継続的な改善を行う。

顧客理解・支援：見込み顧客との最初のやり取りにおいてGTMおよび技術面のリーダーとして顧客ニーズを理解・予見することで、当社のAIソリューションが業界をリードする存在であり続けることに貢献する。

求められる経験・スキル
セールスエンジニア、ソリューションエンジニア、顧客対応テクニカルセールスのいずれかとして5～7年以上の経験。

口頭および文章による非常に優れたコミュニケーション能力。ビジネスレベルの日本語および英語。

GTM部門において、デモの構築や実施、および顧客やクライアントとの協業を行った実務経験。

見込み顧客（経営幹部や技術責任者を含む）との関係構築の経験。

エンタープライズ企業に対する営業活動を主導した経験。

見込み顧客の具体的なビジネス課題とSierraのソリューションを結びつけ、技術系・非技術系の双方の人々に対して説明できる能力。

大卒以上の学位（コンピュータサイエンスまたは関連分野であれば尚可）、あるいは同等の実務経験。

あると望ましい経験・スキル
AI関連の実務経験（または、同様に先進的かつ高度な技術分野での経験）。

コード、技術的ロジック、ユーザー要件を、プロダクト要件やエンジニアリング要件として落とし込んだ経験。

選考プロセス
面接は、英語で実施します。

本人および家族向けの医療、歯科、眼科保険

生命保険および障害保険

雇用国に応じた退職制度

育児休暇

Carrotを通じた、不妊治療および家族形成支援の給付

昼食の支給、およびエネルギーを維持するための美味しいスナックやコーヒーの提供

職務内容
戦略パートナーの営業チームと一体となって動き、Sierraの専門家としてパートナーの営業活動を支援する。Sierraについてのトレーニングを行ったり、顧客との商談に同席したりすることで、パートナーの営業担当者が自信を持ってSierraを提案・販売できる状態をつくる。

パートナー企業の営業部門だけでなく、プロダクト部門なども含めて、Sierraを積極的に推進してくれる人（チャンピオン）を増やし、社内ネットワークをつくる。それによって、案件を増やし、受注までのスピードを上げる。

Sierra Japanのパートナー経由の売上目標に責任を持つ。日本を代表する大手企業に対して、パートナーと連携しながら、案件の発掘から提案、受注まで一貫して推進する。

パートナーやSierraの営業責任者と密に連携し、定期的な振り返り、顧客ごとの営業戦略づくり、案件の進捗管理を行う。これにより、受注までの時間を短縮し、売上成長につなげる。

SierraのグローバルのパートナーシップチームやGTMオペレーションチームと連携し、パートナーがSierraを売りやすくする仕組みをつくる。具体的には、営業向けトレーニング、営業シナリオ、案件の進め方や商流のルール、日々の運用プロセスなどを整備・推進する。

日本市場の顧客や営業現場の声を、Sierra社内に届ける役割を担う。顧客からのフィードバック、営業現場で得た知見、競合情報などを共有し、プロダクト、営業の進め方、市場での見せ方・伝え方の改善につなげる。

顧客との商談、パートナーとの活動、業界イベントなどでSierraの代表として対外的に活動する。日本の大企業市場におけるSierraの知名度と信頼を高める。

求められる経験・スキル
エンタープライズ向けのテクノロジー営業を10年以上経験していること。そのうち、日本市場で8年以上の営業経験があること。

パートナーと協力して大手企業の案件をつくり、受注・売上につなげた実績があること。具体的には、案件の発掘やパイプラインづくり、パートナーの営業担当者への働きかけ、代理店・チャネル経由での営業活動などの経験。大手の戦略パートナーと成果を出した経験があれば、さらに望ましい。

日本のIT・テクノロジー業界にすでに幅広い人脈を持っていること。特に、通信会社、SIer、販売代理店、クラウド事業者、ソフトバンク、NTT、富士通、NECなどの大手企業・戦略パートナーとのネットワークがあること。

日本の大企業特有の「ビジネスの進め方」をよく理解していること。たとえば、購買・調達の仕組み、誰がどのように意思決定するのか、社内承認の進め方、長期的な関係構築の重要性などを深く理解していること。

ネイティブレベルの日本語力（JLPT N2以上相当）と、ビジネスレベルの英語力。

あると望ましい経験・スキル
ソフトバンク、NTT、富士通、NEC、アクセンチュア、デロイト、またはそれらと同等の企業での勤務経験、あるいは密接な協業経験。

急成長中のエンタープライズSaaS企業（Salesforce、ServiceNow、Zendesk、または同等の企業）にて、パートナー主導の収益モデルを構築した経験。

パートナーイネーブルメントプログラム、セールスプレイ、および現場向けトレーニングの開発または実施経験。

共同GTM（Go-To-Market）施策、顧客向けイベント、エグゼクティブ向けエンゲージメントプログラム、またはパートナーマーケティング活動を実施した経験。

CXまたはカスタマーサービス領域のテクノロジーエコシステムにおける経験。

エンタープライズにおけるAI/ML導入、およびソフトバンクのAI戦略やポートフォリオに対する知見。

選考プロセス
面接は、英語と日本語で実施します。

報酬
想定年収：1,900万円～3,400万円

福利厚生

SierraはBret TaylorとClay Bavorによって共同創業されました。Bretは、現在OpenAI取締役会の会長です。前職はSalesforceの共同CEOで（彼が創業したQuipをSalesforceが買収）、FacebookでCTOも務めていました。またGoogleの最初期のプロダクトマネージャーであり、Google Mapsを共同開発しました。Clayは、Sierraを創業する前はGoogleに18年在籍し、最後はGoogle Labsの責任者を務めました。それ以前は、GoogleのAR/VR関連事業（Project Starline、Google Lensなど）やGoogle Workspaceのプロダクト＆デザインチームのリーダーも歴任しています。

職務内容
本番レベルのAIエージェントの設計と提供を主導：高いパフォーマンス、信頼性、直感的な使いやすさを備えたAIエージェントを構築するエンジニアリングチームのマネジメントと育成を担当します。これらのAIエージェントは、Sierraの中核を担うミッションクリティカルなものであり、事業の成長に直結します。これらはプロトタイプではなく、金融、ヘルスケア、コマースなどの業界の本番環境で稼働する、強力で拡張性の高いシステムです。技術的な卓越性、運用の信頼性、そして顧客への高いインパクトを責任をもって実現します。

エージェント開発ライフサイクル（ADLC）の責任者：ライフサイクル全体（初期パイロットから本番デプロイ、継続的な改善まで）を通じてチームを主導します。エンジニアをコーチングし、ADLCのベストプラクティスに関する標準の確立および保守を担当します。プロジェクトの納期を厳守し、顧客ニーズを充足させ、本番環境において効果的に拡張できるようにします。

大企業や最先端スタートアップとのパートナーシップ：世界有数の大企業のリーダーとコラボレーションし、その企業が直面する重要なビジネス課題を理解したうえで、大規模に展開し業務のあり方を変革できるAIエージェントを構築できるようチームを主導します。また、日本の革新的スタートアップとも協業し、彼らの事業全体にAIエージェントを組み込むことで、イノベーションと効率化を推進します。

プラットフォームの未来を形づくる：あなたのチームと顧客との直接的な取り組みが、Sierraの中核プラットフォームの進化を方向づけます。満たされていないニーズを見つけ、取り組みに優先順位を付け、リサーチ、プロダクト、プラットフォームの各チームと協働しながら、AIエージェント開発とSierraのプロダクトの未来を形づくっていきます。

求められる経験・スキル
エンドツーエンドの本番システムの構築および拡張を行うエンジニアリングチームを率いた経験。

技術課題に対する高い解決能力、および不確実で変化の激しい環境においてチームを主導する能力。

ハイスタンダードと共感力を兼ね備え、スピードと品質の両方を実現するリーダーシップスタイル。

顧客と密に連携し、ビジネス要件を技術的な成果物へと落とし込んだ実績。

技術系・非技術系の双方の人々に対する優れたコミュニケーション能力。

コンピュータサイエンスまたは関連分野の学位、または同等の実務経験。

あると望ましい経験・スキル
AI関連分野の実務経験（AIエージェントの開発経験があれば尚可）

本番環境のAI/LLMシステムの構築およびデプロイの経験

創業者、エンジニアリングリード、またはスタートアップの立ち上げ経験があり、高い当事者意識とスピード感を備えていること

最新のAIエージェント用ツールに習熟していること（評価フレームワーク、エージェントツール、RAGパイプライン、プロンプトエンジニアリングなど）

React、TypeScript、Goの経験

顧客対応、または社外ステークホルダーを含む技術プロジェクトを主導した経験

選考プロセス
面接は、英語と日本語で実施します。

福利厚生
私たちは、福利厚生に私たちの価値観を反映させたいと考えており、正社員に以下を提供しています。
柔軟な有給休暇制度

本人および家族向けの医療、歯科、眼科保険

生命保険および障害保険

雇用国に応じた退職制度

育児休暇

Carrotを通じた、不妊治療および家族形成支援の給付

昼食の支給、およびエネルギーを維持するための美味しいスナックやコーヒーの提供

自分が最も重要だと考える用途に使える裁量型福利厚生手当

無料のアルプホルンのレッスン

これらの福利厚生の詳細はSierraの社内規定に定められており、地域によって異なる場合があります。また、適用される報酬・福利厚生制度の条件に従い、随時変更される可能性があります。また、対象となる正社員は、該当する制度や規定に従い、Sierraの株式報酬制度に参加できます。

私たちの価値観
Trust：私たちは、責任を果たし、相手に共感し、高い品質と迅速な対応を貫くことで、お客様との信頼を築きます。AIをより身近で、安全かつ役立つものにすることで、社会からのAIへの信頼にも貢献します。また、仕事でも人としても互いを支え合い、一人ひとりが力を最大限に発揮できる環境をともにつくります。

Customer Obsession：私たちは、お客様のビジネス目標を深く理解し、技術的な達成ではなく、ビジネス成果の実現に徹底してコミットします。全社員がお客様と直接向き合い、その声を聞き、現場を理解します。お客様に問題が起きたときは、他のすべてに優先して対応し、一刻も早く解決します。

Craftsmanship：私たちは、文章からシステムアーキテクチャまで、あらゆる細部にこだわります。良いものを見極める審美眼を持ち、違和感を見過ごさず、時間を惜しまず改善します。自らが生み出すプロダクトに誇りを持ち、振り返りと改善を繰り返しながら、常により良い仕事を追求します。

Intensity：私たちは、スピードが勝敗を分けることを理解しています。常に勝つために行動し、自分たちのプロダクトが最高であることを追求します。そうでないと分かれば、すぐに改善します。失敗は責めるためではなく、次に成功するための学びとしてオープンに共有します。

Family：私たちは、ワークライフバランスと高い成果へのこだわりは両立できると考え、それを自らの行動や組織の仕組みで体現します。子育てをする人にとって最高のテクノロジー企業であることを目指します。互いを支え、尊重し、一人ひとりの仕事上・私生活での成果や喜びをともに祝います。

あなたらしく、私たちと共に
私たちは、AIの変革的な力を世界中のあらゆる組織にもたらすことを目指しています。そのためには、社員の多様性がお客様の多様性を反映していることが重要だと考えています。チーム内のさまざまなスキルや経験を奨励し、支援し、尊重することで、私たちの仕事や文化はより良いものになると信じています。あなたの経験が募集要項に完全に一致していなくても、応募を歓迎します。私たちは、人種、肌の色、宗教、性別、国籍、年齢、障害、退役軍人としての地位、妊娠、性表現および性自認、性的指向、市民権、その他法律で保護されているいかなる属性に関わらず、すべての応募者を一貫して公平に評価するよう努めています。

職務内容
エージェントストラテジスト・リードとして、初期のパイロットから1日に数千件の対話を処理する本番エージェントに至るまで、顧客に合わせたSierraのAIエージェントの実現を担当します。私たちは、最高のリーダーとは常に自ら手を動かし、現場に近いところにいるものだと信じています。プロダクト、エージェント構築、顧客対応が重なり合う領域で、プロダクトの提供相手や自分が率いるチームに対して、また技術そのものとも密接に関わり続けます。
エージェント開発ライフサイクル（ADLC）の主導：入社後3～6か月間はまずIC（Individual Contributor：マネジメント業務を伴わない開発・実務担当）として業務を行い、その後リードとしての役割へと移行します。その間も一貫して、初期スコープ、会話デザイン、ツール連携、評価、リリース、そして本番環境での継続的な改善に至るまで、エージェント開発の全工程を手掛けます。自ら直接エージェントを構築するだけでなく、ライフサイクル全体を通じてチームを主導し、ストラテジストをコーチングしてADLC（エージェント開発ライフサイクル）のベストプラクティスの標準を確立・保守します。エージェントの納期を厳守し、顧客ニーズを充足させ、顧客のビジネスに測定可能な成果をもたらします。

ビジネスを育てながら、チームも育てる：主要顧客プロジェクトのシニアスポンサー、およびストラテジストチームのマネージャという、2つのリーダーシップを担います。採用・オンボーディングから、成功基準の策定まで、ストラテジスト組織の成長を主導します。

大手企業のリーダーたちから信頼される戦略アドバイザー：顧客企業の経営幹部と緊密に連携して、彼らが求めるビジネス上の成功を深く理解し、それを実現するためのAI戦略を主体的に構築・具現化します。また、他のチームメンバーも同様の役割を果たせるよう育成します。

顧客側担当チームとの日々の開発業務を主導：ワークショップの実施、課題発生時のエージェントのトラブルシューティング、またリリースに向けて各段階を予定通り進めるための意思決定ができるよう、チームにコーチングを行います。自分のチームが担当するすべての案件において、成果物の品質と顧客へのビジネスインパクトに責任を持ちます。

プロダクトの未来の形成：あなたのチームと顧客との直接的な取り組みが、Sierraの中核プラットフォームの進化を方向づけます。満たされていないニーズを見つけ、取り組みに優先順位を付け、リサーチ、プロダクト、プラットフォームの各チームと協働することが、Sierraの将来に影響を与えます。

求められる経験・スキル
顧客第一主義（カスタマーオブセッション）：顧客と真摯に向き合い、相手のビジネスやニーズを理解して複雑な組織内で実力を発揮し、信頼関係を築けること。加えて、そのような能力を持つチームメンバーを育成できること。

コミュニケーション：技術系・非技術系の双方の人々に対して、明確、率直、かつ説得力のあるコミュニケーションが取れること。

不確実な状況下での戦略的課題解決力：高度な分析力とクリティカルシンキングにより複雑な課題を分解し、リスクを早期に察知して、変化が激しく不確実な環境下でチームを導けること。

現場経験に基づくリーダーシップスタイル：ハイスタンダードと共感力を兼ね備え、チーム全体でスピードと品質の両方を高められること。

技術の受容力：技術的な概念に抵抗なく直接向き合えること。

遂行責任と成果の実現：自分自身で、またチームリーダーとして、複雑かつ注目度の高いプロジェクトを複数同時に推進し、成果を出した実績。

あると望ましい経験・スキル
技術担当者と緊密に連携し、本番環境でAI/LLMエージェントを構築あるいはデプロイしたいずれかの経験。関連ツール（評価フレームワーク、エージェントツール、RAG、プロンプトエンジニアリングなど）の実務経験。

創業者、プロダクト/ストラテジーリーダー、またはスタートアップでの業務担当の経験があり、高い当事者意識とスピード感を備えていること。

プロダクト、コンサルティング、ソリューションといった顧客対応が必要なチームのマネジメント経験。

コンピュータサイエンス、エンジニアリング、数学、または関連する技術分野の学位、または同等の実務経験。MBA、あるいはテクノロジーとビジネスの両領域にまたがる同等の経験。

プロジェクト例
実際に Agent Strategist が担当しているプロジェクトには、以下のようなものがあります。
大手通信会社やメディア企業向けに、解約リスクの高い顧客を引き留めるAIエージェントを企画・構築・運用し、人間のオペレーターを上回る成果を実現。

EC・コマース企業向けに、故障した製品のトラブルシューティングから最適な商品提案までを一つの対話で完結するAIエージェントを構築。

金融機関向けに、複雑な規制要件を満たす対話フローを設計・改善し、PoCから複数部門で利用される本番環境への展開をリード。

実際のお客様と協働しながら、新しいAIエージェントアーキテクチャやセルフサービス機能など、新規プロダクト機能の企画・設計に従事。

新しいAIエージェントの評価指標や品質基準を策定し、その指標をもとに継続的な改善を行い、ビジネス成果を週次で向上。

jobs.title: Account Manager - India
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

About the Role
We're hiring a System Architect to build the engine behind our full-funnel lifecycle programs across Creator, Enterprise, and Developer segments. This is not a marketing technologist role — we're not looking for someone to maintain the stack. We're looking for someone to design the machine that runs on it.
The core challenge: today, every new industry, segment, or language means another fork — another campaign tree, another set of manual sequences to maintain. Your job is to make those parameters instead. You'll architect a lifecycle system where launching a new vertical in a new market is a configuration change, not a rebuild, and where onboarding, nurture, upsell, and ABM programs compose from shared logic rather than duplicated effort.
You'll be both architect and operator — defining the data model and segmentation logic underneath the journeys, then shipping them. You'll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth, and Data, and you'll scope engineering support rather than queue behind it. This is a build year: you're inventing the system, not inheriting one.

Key Responsibilities
Architect a parameterised lifecycle system where new industries, segments, and languages are configuration, not new campaign trees

Design and launch onboarding, nurture, and upsell campaigns across Creator, Enterprise, and Developer segments

Prototype and ship your own integrations and logic; you scope engineering help, you don't queue behind it

Own lifecycle touchpoints across channels with clear, measurable goals

Build multilingual nurture flows that scale globally, maintaining message quality and performance

Set up and manage robust A/B testing plans and track performance across the full funnel

Own the reporting framework for lifecycle marketing; define success metrics and communicate learnings

Build ABM infrastructure for targeted, account-level nurture and retention programs

Partner with the design and engineering teams to deploy campaigns that require light integration or tech support

Bring structure and governance to lifecycle strategy—ensuring data hygiene, segmentation accuracy, and QA rigor

Who You Are
You think in funnels and systems, not one-off campaigns. You're equally comfortable in the weeds of a HubSpot workflow and in a room with Sales talking about pipeline quality. You default to testing and measuring rather than guessing, and you're excited about using AI to do more with less — automating the repetitive work so you can focus on strategy and experimentation. You move fast, take ownership of outcomes, and collaborate easily across marketing, sales, and product.

What You Bring
4+ years in B2B lifecycle, demand gen, or marketing automation roles, ideally at a high-growth SaaS company

Deep proficiency in HubSpot — building workflows, scoring models, and automated nurture programs

Working knowledge of Salesforce and how marketing and sales data connect end-to-end

Experience building and managing lead scoring and MQL/SQL/PQL funnels

Experience running or supporting ABM programs for target accounts

Strong analytical skills — comfortable owning funnel metrics and translating data into action

Excellent cross-functional communication, especially with Sales and RevOps

Nice to Have
Experience building AI-powered marketing workflows — for personalization, content generation, or campaign automation

Experience marketing to developer or technical buyer personas

Familiarity with product-led growth motions and PQL-to-enterprise conversion

SQL or basic data querying skills

Growth potential
We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:
Lead social strategy across all ElevenLabs brands and sub-brands as the social function scales

Move into a broader content role spanning video, editorial, and social

Expand into brand marketing or creative direction as the growth team evolves

Day to day you will work closely with the paid marketing team: fixing tracking bugs as they come in, setting up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debugging discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data. Longer term, you will define how tracking should properly work here and build the monitoring so we catch breakage in hours, not weeks.
This role sits between frontend engineering, data engineering, and marketing. You will add and improve tracking scripts without hurting pagespeed, keep our server-side GTM container healthy, make sure consent and regional restrictions are correctly enforced, and ensure the right channels get credit for the right conversions. Your work directly decides how a large paid budget gets allocated.

What you will do

Work with the paid marketing team daily: fix tracking bugs, set up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debug discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data

Build and maintain server-to-server conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, and similar) and validate pixel vs server deduplication

Improve tracking script performance and correctness, keeping script impact on pagespeed and Core Web Vitals within budget

Make sure consent handling and regional restrictions are correctly enforced across markets

Define event schema and UTM conventions, and document them so tracking for new campaigns is correct by default

Build monitoring and alerting for the measurement stack so we catch broken tracking within hours, not weeks

Review PRs that add conversion events to the main app, and work with product engineering on tracking integrations

Requirements

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across France. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across France, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.
In this role, you will:
Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)
Identify government partnership opportunities across France — from healthcare and education to transport, public banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.

Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.

Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)
Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across France, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company — including EU-level developments given France's influence in shaping EU AI policy.

Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

What you bring:
Primary requirements
10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

A wide, current network of contacts across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs, including in healthcare, education, and transport. Prior government or grands corps experience is a plus but not required if network breadth is strong.

Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

Contacts or experience navigating EU institutions or other major European markets is a plus.

Also required
Strong knowledge of the French and EU AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights.

Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

Public policy experience across France.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

Fluency in English and French.

Location
This role is located in France.

We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment.

Responsibilities
Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls.

Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements.

Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data.

Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle.

Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records.

Manage processes for data subject and consumer rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, and opt-out requests, and help ensure requests are handled consistently and within applicable deadlines.

Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation.

Support privacy incident response and regulatory or customer inquiries by coordinating documentation, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions.

Implement and administer privacy tooling and automation to improve the efficiency and scalability of privacy operations including maintaining ElevenLabs’ consent management platform and partnering with Legal, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cookie, tracking technology, and other consent and preference mechanisms are appropriately configured, documented, monitored, and updated as our products and regulatory requirements evolve.

Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders.

Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance.

Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company.

Who you are
Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data.

An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams.

Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction.

Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you bring
6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company.

Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements.

Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation.

Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks.

Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams.

Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar.

Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus.

Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Location
This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York.

About the role
The ElevenLabs Impact Program exists to democratize access to our technology and make AI work for all people, supporting for-good use cases across healthcare, education, and culture. Today, our work includes providing free and discounted access to nonprofits, partnering with university professors to bring voice AI into the classroom and the research lab, and working to restore the voices of one million people living with permanent voice loss through our 1 Million Voices initiative (learn more at elevenlabs.io/impact). We're looking for a Producer to own the external storytelling and event presence for Impact, a role that coordinates PR, agency management, social launches, documentary-style case studies, and event production. This is a hands-on, in-house role: you're the person who makes sure every launch, film, and activation meets (or, ideally raises) the bar of the rest of the company's output, working closely with our internal Design, Comms, and Events teams, and, when applicable, with the external agencies and production teams supporting PR, film, and creative execution. Much of Impact’s work is made with people who live with a disability, or are members of vulnerable communities. You will ensure their views carry equal weight and their input helps shape every project, from first conversation to final cut. As Impact's first dedicated producer, you'll build the production and launch engine for a team whose external footprint is scaling fast; this quarter alone includes more than five events, six documentaries in production, two live ElevenLabs Summit sessions, a partner launch every month, and several more case studies in flight.

Coordinate production of Impact's documentary case studies: travel and work onsite for filming when needed, work closely with external production and direction teams, bringing opinions on story and craft, and partner with our Design team to make sure every film meets ElevenLabs' bar and brand guidelines.

Work alongside subjects of our case studies, many of whom live with a disability, as equals and ensure that the production team does the same. You will build in consent, access needs, and editorial input at every stage to ensure alignment in how the story is told, cut, and shared.

Plan and execute Impact's conferences and activations alongside the Events team, turning each one into an in-person moment that drives real ROI and leaves a lasting impression, with Impact's own storytelling angle built in.

Support Comms in telling Impact's story through PR, coordinating with Comms and, when applicable, a PR agency to keep press windows and partner announcements on track, and helping make sure Impact's international stories get told well as the program expands globally.

Partner with Design to keep all video and static collateral on-brand, advocating for a high creative standard and Impact’s lens.

Carry a consistent visual and narrative thread across launches, blog content, and ElevenLabs Summit presentations.

Draft copy for social and blog content, collaborating with Comms to land a final draft, and with Design on all launch-related visual assets.

Manage multiple concurrent launches, shoots, and events at once.

Requirements
A great project manager with a sharp creative eye, someone who runs cross-functional logistics flawlessly, has real taste, and will push the team to hit it.

Proven practical experience working with vulnerable communities, especially people living with a disability, and ensuring they are provided the time, space and accommodation to be equal partners in high-pressure productions, on tight timelines, and in public.

Organized and detail-oriented, with a track record of juggling several production timelines at once.

Creative or production background (agency, marketing, in-house brand/content team, documentary or branded content) comfortable being on set and in the room with Design, not just commissioning the work.

Strong writing and visual taste; can tell when something is on-brand and polish-worthy.

2-5 years of experience in production, events, or brand marketing.

Comfortable traveling for shoots and events.

About the role
As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.
 No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:
Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents.

Own flagship deals end-to-end — from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close.

Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.

Identify high-impact use cases through close engagement with customer problems and workflows, and collaborate with Forward Deployed Software Engineers to bring them to life.

Guide customers on best practices for deploying our products (e.g. ElevenAgents); including agent design, agent orchestration, production readiness to maximize adoption and impact.

Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

Collaborate with our Research teams to feed field insights back into ElevenLabs' platform and models, helping shape the roadmap.

Build and deliver compelling demos of ElevenAgents and our broader AI technology to new and existing customers.

Collaborate daily with customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure agents reach production and deliver measurable business outcomes.

 Requirements
3+ years of experience working with customers in a technical capacity. Direct enterprise customer experience is preferred.

Experience in product development, delivery, and change management

Commercial instinct: comfort engaging in deal conversations, structuring value propositions, and navigating enterprise sales cycles alongside GTM partners.

Basic proficiency in Python and familiarity with API integration, sufficient to prototype, demo, and communicate credibly with engineering teams.

Excellent communication and problem-solving skills; particularly the ability to simplify complex technical concepts and structure clear logic in pursuit of optimal solutions.

A proven track record of taking ownership of complex, ambiguous projects and delivering results.

Adaptability to work across different customer environments, industries, and technical use cases.

Technical aptitude and familiarity with common LLM, tooling and AI agent frameworks.

Ability to creatively map enterprise use cases and workflows to AI systems
 

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Argentina, with a preference of Buenos Aires. Expect regular travel for customer onsite. Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

#LI-Remote
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Systems mindset: you can hold an end-to-end process in your head, trace a field from its origin through every downstream dependency, and anticipate what breaks when something changes.

About the role
ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents.
This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.
On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.
This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.
You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.
In this role you will
Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs.

Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases.

Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer.

Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why.

Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions.

Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset.

Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.

Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.

Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.

Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.

Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it.

Requirements
10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving.

Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities.

Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.

Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.

Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly.

Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective.

Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives.

A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools.

Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor.

Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work.

Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

Bonus points
Experience in strategy or management consulting, particularly in operational transformation, technology, customer experience, or growth.

Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business.

Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation.

Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer.

Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Location
This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office.
You will work with customers and ElevenLabs teams across regions and should expect travel for customer meetings and onsite work when it meaningfully advances the work.
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

CPA

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About Cohere and North
Cohere is revolutionizing enterprise AI with North, an agentic AI platform designed to securely deploy AI agents and automations within organizations' infrastructure. North empowers employees to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and unlock actionable insights while ensuring data privacy and compliance. North combines cutting-edge generative and search models with customizable integrations to drive productivity and innovation at scale.

Role Overview
We are seeking an Agent Harness Product Manager to own the execution layer that makes North agents reliable, capable, and production-ready. This is a role that sits at the intersection of three domains:

Agent Loop and Execution. 
Own the core agent runtime: tool orchestration, parallel execution, sub-agent delegation, sandbox code execution, and failure recovery. You will define how North agents plan and act across long, multi-step workflows and ensure the execution environment is robust enough for the most demanding enterprise tasks. You are expected to engage at the implementation level, contributing to architecture decisions alongside engineering rather than simply handing off requirements.

Context Engineering. 
Own how our Agents manage the context window as a deliberately controlled resource. This includes progressive disclosure of tools and skills, context compaction and summarization, offloading of large payloads to a persistent filesystem, and the instrumentation that keeps agents oriented across extended trajectories.

Model-Scaffolding Co-evolution. 
Own the feedback loop between North's harness and the Modeling Team. This PM is the connective tissue that makes that possible: ensuring harness design decisions are validated by Modeling before they are built, that evals are the shared bridge between both teams, and that as the harness evolves the model evolves with it.

Responsibilities
Define and own the roadmap for North's agent harness, including the agent loop, context engineering layer, tool orchestration, sandbox execution, and sub-agent delegation

Serve as the primary interface between North engineering and Cohere's Modeling team, ensuring new harness capabilities are validated before being built and that neither team paints itself into a corner

Own North's agentic evaluation framework, ensuring evals are compatible with both the North harness and Modeling's training infrastructure, and that they serve as a reliable bridge between product and research

Engage enterprise customers to surface real-world agentic failures and translate findings into concrete product and model requirements

Partner with the agentic expert modeling team to define goals that maximize the impact of our models and prioritize model capabilities and evals most critical for delivering on those goals. Establish a clear roadmap for our agentic modeling capabilities.

Stay current with the open-source and commercial agent ecosystem and drive adoption decisions that keep North's architecture aligned with emerging standards.

Requirements
5+ years of product management experience as a research PM, in agentic AI systems,, or applied ML products

Deep understanding of agentic harnesses, including the latest paid and open source offerings.

Deep understanding of modern LLM agent architectures, including multi-agent systems, tool-augmented reasoning, memory and retrieval, programmatic orchestration, RAG, and long-horizon execution

Strong grasp of agentic evaluation design, including how to measure task completion, failure recovery, and long-horizon reliability, and how to diagnose model vs. scaffolding gaps

Technically deep enough to contribute to architecture decisions at the implementation level: comfortable reviewing and shaping design docs, reasoning about async execution patterns, sandboxed environments, filesystem design, and the tradeoffs that come with building harness capabilities into a production platform

Ability to flex between ML research conversations and engineering architecture discussions with equal fluency

Track record of shipping platform-layer products with demonstrated impact on reliability, performance, or capability.

Nice-to-Haves
Direct experience in developing and shipping leading agentic harnesses.

An active practitioner of agent frameworks who regularly builds with and follows the latest developments in open-source harnesses, coding agents, and orchestration tools in both professional and personal work

Hands-on experience with enterprise agentic deployments: multi-tenant orchestration, tool permissioning, audit trails, and compliance requirements

Familiarity with infrastructure constraints relevant to enterprise deployments: on-premises environments, scalability challenges, and the operational tradeoffs of running complex agent workloads in restricted or air-gapped settings

Prior work at the intersection of research and product, translating nascent model capabilities into shipped product features

Background working within or closely alongside an ML research or post-training team.

jobs.description:

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

Why this role?
The Data Infrastructure team at Cohere is responsible for the storage and data movement layer underlying every model training run. We're building the unified storage layer that feeds our training workloads. It needs to serve petabytes of training data and model checkpoints fast enough to keep thousands of GPUs busy across several training clusters. In this role, you’d have an opportunity to build this system from the ground up. You’d be a key contributor, working on a problem few teams have had to solve at this scale.

In this role, you will:
Design, build, and operate the distributed storage system that feeds model training and evaluation.

Run this system multiple on Kubernetes clusters at petabyte scale.

Work with researchers and training-infra teams on how jobs actually read and write data, and turn that into throughput, latency, and durability requirements

Work through the networking, I/O, and consistency problems of moving large datasets and checkpoints across regions and backends, with GPU idle time and time-to-insight as the measures of success

You may be a good fit if you have:
Strong storage fundamentals, including replication, consistency, caching, and data lifecycle management.

Strong coding ability. We work in Python and Go; experience in either is enough, but you should be willing to pick up the other

Experience running stateful systems on Kubernetes, including Persistent Volumes, CSI drivers, and StatefulSets.

Hands-on experience with cloud object storage such as S3 as well as POSIX-style filesystems.

It’s a bonus if you have:
Experience with parallel or HPC filesystems such as Weka, VAST, or Lustre.

Familiarity with the data-loading and checkpointing patterns used in large-scale model training.

An interest in how large models are trained and evaluated, including the trajectory and eval data those runs generate, and a desire to understand the workloads the platform is serving.

You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of Canadian federal departments, provincial agencies, Crown corporations, and defence organizations. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions.
In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government engagements.

Location: Ottawa required 
Security Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance strongly preferred; candidates eligible and willing to obtain clearance will also be considered.

What You'll Do
Customer Program Leadership:
Own end-to-end technical program delivery for Canadian public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling

Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for government customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams

Translate complex government requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans

Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organization, customer stakeholders, and government leadership

Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds

Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior government officials and departmental executives

Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts.

Complex Program Management:
Create and manage project schedules that account for government timelines, security review processes, and ministerial approval cycles

Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams

Navigate risks unique to government deployments: privacy compliance, Algorithmic Impact Assessments, Treasury Board submissions, security authorizations

Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific government requirements.

Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet government-grade security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards

Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customization, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support

Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government deployments

Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments.

Required Experience:
6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery.

Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.

Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers (public sector, defence contractors).

Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements.

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus.

Technical Background:
Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)

Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator

Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders.

Government & Defence Acumen:
Deep understanding of how government organizations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology

Familiarity with Canadian government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications

Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment

Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset

Eligible to obtain Canadian government security clearance (Top Secret preferred)

Active Canadian government security clearance (Secret or Top Secret) - strong preference for active Top Secret clearance

Bilingual (English/French) proficiency

Background in or strong familiarity with Canadian defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors

Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments

Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies.

This role requires eligibility for Canadian government security clearance.
Strong preference will be given to candidates who currently hold an active Top Secret (TS) clearance, as this will enable immediate engagement with our most sensitive defence and national security customers.

Currently hold Secret clearance and are eligible for TS upgrade

Do not currently hold clearance, but are eligible and willing to undergo the Top Secret clearance process

This isn't typical program management—it's a highly specialized role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. jobs.description:
Who are we?
Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
Why This Role?
We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on UK public sector and defence accounts. This is a highly specialised role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organisations.
You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of UK Government and defence organisations. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions.
In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government engagements.
Location: UK
Security Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance preferred; candidates with Active Secret clearance or those who are eligible and willing to obtain clearance will also be considered.
What You'll Do
Customer Program Leadership:
Own end-to-end technical program delivery for UK public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling

Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for government customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams

Translate complex government requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans

Navigate government procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations.

Strategic Communication:
Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organisation, customer stakeholders, and government leadership

Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds

Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior government officials and departmental executives

Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts.

Complex Program Management:
Create and manage project schedules that account for government timelines, security review processes, and ministerial approval cycles

Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams

Navigate risks unique to government deployments: privacy compliance, security authorisations, technical and infrastructure constraints

Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific government requirements.

Technical Delivery & Execution:
Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet government-grade security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards

Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customisation, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support

Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government deployments

Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments.

You May Be a Good Fit If:
Required Experience:
6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery.

Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.

Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers (public sector, defence contractors).

Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements.

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus.

Technical Background:
Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)

Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator

Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders.

Government & Defence Acumen:
Deep understanding of how government organisations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology

Familiarity with UK government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications

Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment

Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset

Eligible to obtain UK government security clearance (Top Secret preferred)

Nice to Have:
Active UK government security clearance (Secret or Top Secret) - preference for active Top Secret clearance

Background in or strong familiarity with UK defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors

Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments

Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies.

Security Clearance Requirements
This role requires eligibility for UK government security clearance.
Preference will be given to candidates who currently hold an active UK government Top Secret (TS) clearance, as this will enable immediate engagement with our most sensitive defence and national security customers.
However, we will also consider exceptional candidates who:
Currently hold UK government Secret clearance and are eligible for TS upgrade

Do not currently hold clearance, but are eligible and willing to undergo the Top Secret clearance process

Have a previous government security clearance that has lapsed

Please note that obtaining Top Secret clearance can take 12-18 months. Candidates without active clearance will work on non-classified public sector accounts while the clearance process is underway.
What Makes This Role Unique
This isn't typical program management—it's a highly specialised role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. jobs.title: Data Annotation Specialist, Generalist
jobs.location: Canada / Calgary / Winnipeg / Vancouver / Halifax / Edmonton / Toronto / Victoria / Montreal / Canada
jobs.description:
Who are we?
Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
Why this role?
We are on a mission to build machines that understand the world and make them safely accessible to all. Data quality is foundational to this process. Machines (or Large Language Models, to be exact) learn in similar ways to humans, by way of feedback. By labelling, ranking, auditing, and correcting model output, you will improve Large Language Models' performance for iterations to come, thus having a lasting impact on Cohere's technology. We are hiring Generalist professionals with broad backgrounds that span multiple consumer-facing or personal domains.
This is a judgment-driven role, not passive data entry. You will review, assess, and provide structured feedback across a broad and evolving range of tasks, evaluating, stress-testing, and improving our models on English-language data spanning multiple modalities (text, image, and structured formats such as JSON, CSV/TSV, and Markdown). This is a great opportunity for professionals with strong analytical skills to contribute to high-impact annotation projects.
Please Note: This is a part-time independent contractor position available within Canada only. We seek candidates who can commit to 16 hours per week at a CAD $30/hour contract rate. This role is BYOD 💻 (Bring Your Own Device, laptop). This position is remote.
As an Data Annotation Specialist, you will:
Evaluate and rank model outputs: Complete preference and comparison tasks, assessing which responses best conform to project guidelines for accuracy, helpfulness, tone, and safety, and writing clear justifications for your judgments.

Stress-test and break models: Probe models adversarially to surface failure modes, unsafe behavior, and capability gaps, and document reproducible cases that engineering and research teams can act on.

Create datasets: Author high-quality prompts, responses, and exemplars to build training and evaluation datasets, following detailed specifications and editing machine-written or human-written outputs to standard.

Build and apply rubrics and taxonomies: Contribute to the design of grading criteria and rubrics, then apply them consistently to produce structured, high-quality annotations across task types.

Annotate and correct multimodal data: Label, audit, and rectify inaccuracies across text, image, and structured data, maintaining a high standard of data integrity and accuracy.

Calibrate and maintain consistency: Participate in calibration exercises and inter-annotator agreement checks to align on standards, and flag ambiguous or uncovered edge cases rather than guessing, since a single misjudgment replicated at scale degrades a model.

Adapt to experimental work: Take on new and evolving task types as project needs shift, applying sound judgment in areas where guidelines are still being developed.

Report on model performance: Surface and communicate quality and performance trends in model and agent behavior, giving cross-functional partners clear, well-evidenced feedback on where models succeed, fail, and degrade.

You may be a good fit if you have:
1+ years of experience in AI data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, research, or a related analytical role, with exposure to quality assurance, and/or preference ranking.

Experience applying detailed guidelines to complex and often ambiguous content, with strong contextual and sociocultural judgment, sensitivity to nuance, tone, and register, and the ability to reason well in cases where there is no single correct answer.

Comfort with ambiguity: a willingness to flag unclear or uncovered edge cases rather than guess, and to work productively on novel, experimental tasks whose definitions are still evolving.

A sharp, curious eye for inconsistencies, subtle errors, and model failure modes, including the instinct to probe models adversarially and surface where they break. Familiarity with how large language models behave, such as hallucination, sycophancy, and instruction-following gaps, is a plus.

Excellent command of written English and strong reading comprehension, with the ability to clearly justify your evaluations, including why an output is correct or incorrect, high-quality or low-quality, and to write clear prompts and exemplars that explain your reasoning. Bonus points if you are fluent in another language!

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, with the ability to maintain consistency across high-volume and monotonous tasks.

Comfort working with annotation platforms and structured formats such as JSON, CSV/TSV, Markdown, XML, and YAML.

Strong execution in a remote environment, including good time management, comfort using new tools, and the ability to work independently in a global, asynchronous team.

Candidate Journey
Initial Screening: Our Talent Team will review your application.

First Assessment: If selected to move forward, you’ll receive a multiple-choice assessment by email.

Second Assessment: Candidates who achieve a passing score will be contacted by a member of our team to complete a more comprehensive assessment focused on their area of expertise.

Video Screen: If selected to move forward, you’ll have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team.

Final: Selected candidates will receive an Independent Contractor Agreement.

As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously, although we ask you to declare if any of these are with a direct competitor of Cohere and maintain IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by contractors invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor.
It is important to understand that as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed. The client-contractor relationship is fundamentally project-based, meaning engagements may be temporary, periodic, or intermittent based on our organizational needs and project availability. As an independent contractor, you should anticipate fluctuations in workflow and, therefore, compensation for services when Cohere does not require as many hours of services in a week.
Prospective candidates, please be advised: this role involves working with human-generated and model-generated tasks that may involve exposure to not safe for work (NSFW) text content as part of data annotation tasks, including explicit, offensive, or other inappropriate material.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Agents & Automations
jobs.location: Toronto / Canada / New York / United Kingdom / Ottawa / Montreal / Canada
jobs.description:
Who are we?
Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?
North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.
Some of our most important work is making the agents and AI-powered experiences inside North genuinely useful in the workflows customers rely on every day. These systems become valuable when users can build with them, steer them, inspect their work, recover from errors, and trust them to complete messy tasks inside real enterprise environments.
This role is about making those AI experiences reliable, useful, and production-ready. You’ll work with product engineering, modelling and design to turn model capability into reliable, user-facing systems: agent builders, eval frameworks, proactive intelligence, and new interfaces for collaborating with AI. Sometimes that means shipping a new product surface, sometimes a better eval or feedback loop, sometimes prompt and context experiments, and sometimes redesigning the workflow so the model is being asked to do the right thing.

As an Applied AI Engineer, Agents & Automations, you will:
Build AI-powered product experiences that help users create, configure, evaluate, and improve workflows across North.

Design and ship new interfaces for interacting with models, including workflow builders, proactive assistants, review flows, and other human-AI collaboration patterns.

Build eval, observability, and feedback systems that measure whether AI experiences succeed in real enterprise workflows.

Improve AI reliability through product design, prompting, context construction, tool-use strategies, instrumentation, and feedback loops.

Turn production failures, user feedback, and real-task data into better product behavior, stronger eval suites, regression tests, and signals for modelling.

Work closely with modelling, product, design, customer teams, and domain experts to define what “good” means for specific workflows and ship measurable improvements.

Help decide when a workflow needs a more constrained product experience, a better model interface, a stronger eval, or a deeper modelling investment.

Example problems you might work on include helping users build AI automations from natural language, creating evals for multi-step agent workflows, adding proactive intelligence inside the product, or creating interfaces that make agent behavior easier to inspect, steer, and trust.

As the Senior Director of Solutions Architecture for Asia Pacific at Cohere, you will own Solutions Architecture across the region. Our customers here are banks, telcos, industrials and governments who cannot send their data to someone else’s cloud, and who are past experimenting and into production. You will lead the team that makes those deployments real, and you will be accountable for the technical win across the region.
This is a build. Today a Solutions Architecture team covers Korea, Japan and Southeast Asia. You will own that team, grow it, and build the in-region depth this market needs. You will be expected to open doors on your own credibility and network from your first weeks, set direction for the function, sit on the Solution Architecture leadership team alongside the regional leaders for the Americas and EMEA, and contribute to company-wide decisions with your peers across Sales, Product and Engineering.
In this role, you will:
Build and Lead the Team: Hire, coach and develop the Asia Pacific Solutions Architecture organization, and establish in-region depth rather than relying on support flown in from other regions.

Open Doors Across the Region: Bring industry knowledge, technical credibility and an existing network to get Cohere into strategic accounts quickly. This is the central expectation of the role and you should expect to be measured on it.

Own the Technical Win: Be personally accountable for the technical outcome of the region’s most strategic pursuits, and be in the room for the ones that decide the year.

Set Direction for the Function: Define the vision, strategy, coverage model and operating rhythm for Asia Pacific Solutions Architecture across three markets that buy differently and regulate differently.

Architect Sovereign and Regulated Deployments: Lead customers into secure, scalable, production-ready agentic AI deployments across cloud, hybrid, VPC, on-premises and air-gapped environments, which is where much of this region’s demand sits.

Build Repeatable Solution Practices: Establish scalable solution-selling methodologies, industry playbooks, executive narratives, business cases and technical delivery frameworks that improve consistency and win rates.

Partner with Regional Sales Leadership: Own territory, coverage and pipeline jointly with the Asia Pacific sales leader, and be accountable for the number together.

Shape Product Direction: Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate Asia Pacific customer needs into platform improvements and roadmap priorities. You will be one of a handful of people who can tell our product organization what this region actually requires.

Key Responsibilities:
Build and develop the Asia Pacific Solutions Architecture team through hiring, coaching, performance management and career development.

Partner with regional Sales leadership to pursue and close strategic enterprise opportunities across financial services, telecommunications, industrials, technology and the public sector.

Establish and own the regional coverage model across Korea, Japan and Southeast Asia, and make the case for where the team grows next.

Lead executive workshops, discovery sessions, solution presentations and technical deep dives with C-suite and senior customer stakeholders.

Develop business cases, solution architectures, implementation roadmaps and technical proposals that align customer objectives with Cohere’s platform.

Guide customers through the deployment of enterprise AI solutions, ensuring scalability, security, governance, data residency and operational readiness.

Create repeatable solution assets, industry playbooks and best practices that enable the team to consistently deliver high-quality customer engagements.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales and Customer Success to ensure alignment between customer needs and platform evolution, and contribute to decisions that reach beyond your own function.

Serve as the voice of the region by capturing customer feedback and competitive insights that influence product strategy.

Own and report on the region’s operational and commercial metrics, including technical win rates, pipeline health, coverage and team performance.

What We’re Looking For:
Leadership Experience: 15+ years in Solutions Architecture, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting or Enterprise Architecture, including 7+ years leading customer-facing technical teams, and a record of developing people into senior and leadership roles.

Regional Depth and Network: You have built or run a technical organization across more than one Asia Pacific market, you understand how enterprise technology is actually bought in each of them, and you have a network of senior technical and executive relationships you are willing to be measured on.

People Leadership: A proven record of hiring, coaching and developing high-performing Solutions Architecture or Solutions Engineering teams, including building a team in-region from a small base.

Hands-On Technical Credibility: You are technical enough to be believed by a strong engineering bench. You have put real AI systems into production, you can pressure-test your team’s architecture, and you can be the most useful person in a design conversation when it matters. We care far more about what you have deployed, and what broke, than about which models you can name.

Commercial Acumen: A demonstrated ability to partner with enterprise Sales leadership, influence strategic deals, and articulate business value to executive stakeholders. You have carried a number and can point to deals you personally moved.

Executive Presence: You command a room. You are credible in front of a CEO and their business leaders as well as a Chief Information Officer, a Chief AI Officer or a Chief Information Security Officer, and you can move between the business case and the architecture without losing either audience.

Technical Expertise: A strong understanding of modern AI architectures, including large language models, agentic systems, retrieval, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, hybrid and on-premises deployments, security and governance.

Enterprise Experience: Experience designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions in complex, regulated or large-scale environments.

Experience building an AI, machine learning or data science function inside a large regulated enterprise, and taking it into production.

Depth in Asia Pacific financial services, telecommunications or the public sector.

Experience deploying into environments where the customer controls the infrastructure, including on-premises, sovereign and air-gapped deployments.

Background in enterprise AI, cloud, or data platform companies, or applied AI consulting organizations.

Experience building repeatable solution-selling methodologies and helping generalist technical teams operate at a consistently high level.

Working proficiency in a regional language in addition to English.
